## About
Parts Unlimited is a family-owned and operated auto yard on Pearland Sites Rd. in Pearland. We sell good-quality new and recycled auto parts at competitive prices, and if you have an old car you're done with, you can sell it to us.
Most of the recycled parts we sell go through quality checks, and we offer warranties on our parts and labor warranties too. We're members of the Texas Automotive Recyclers Association and the Automotive Recyclers Association.
Customers rate us 4.4 on Google from 123 reviews. One reviewer called it top notch commitment to customers and recommended us to anyone looking for used parts.

## Services
- Recycled auto parts: A wide range of domestic and foreign recycled parts, backed by a 90-day warranty.
- New auto parts: New parts for domestic and foreign vehicles at our auto yard.
- Sell your car: Got an old car you don't need anymore? Bring it by the yard. We buy them.

## FAQ
Q: Do you ship parts outside the Houston area?
A: Yes. We ship nationwide, and if the part you need is in stock, we'll ship it within 24 hours.

Q: What if I need to return a part?
A: We give refunds, not store credit.

Q: Can I get a longer warranty?
A: Yes. You can also get a lifetime extended warranty on our auto parts. Call us for the details.
